_readme: Announcer soundbites. Each key is a line ID; <event>_<n> are variants of one event. To replace the robot voice, render a line and save it as audio/announcer/<ID>.mp3 (or .wav/.ogg/.m4a), then run python3 build.py. Lines without a file are silent (the game never uses text-to-speech). Keys starting with _ are ignored.
